title: Frontend heads the quantities page "Consignment details"; Design release 1 heads the same page "Commodity details".

finding.frontend: The page that lists what has been chosen and asks for a count per species is headed "Consignment details" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/consignment-details/consignment-details.njk:9, with the string at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/copy/copy.en.js:16). The same words are used again as the browser tab title and as the last breadcrumb, so the name appears three times on the captured page.
finding.prototype: The same page — selected commodities, a Remove per row, "Add another commodity", then a count per species — is headed "Commodity details", and that is also its page name for the browser tab (app/views/consignment-details.html:3, rendered as the heading at app/views/consignment-details.html:45). "Consignment" is used on Design release 1 for the caption above the heading, "About the consignment", which sits over several pages of this section rather than this one.
finding.difference: Rename the page from "Consignment details" to "Commodity details" in the commodities copy file, which carries it once and feeds the heading, the tab title and the breadcrumb together. The Welsh copy file beside it carries the same title. Nothing has to land first. Note that this is the page's own name and not the section caption above it, which is a separate difference owned by the service-wide slice. No control is named: the finding is about the page heading, which is not a control and would crop to the whole page anyway.
finding.falsifiedBy: A root view on the requirements side heading this page "Consignment details". app/views/consignment-details.html sets pageName and the h1 to "Commodity details" in both places; only the file name says "consignment".
finding.verification: Read both rendered DOMs and both 2x page shots. Ran the falsifier against the root view: app/views/consignment-details.html:3 sets pageName to "Commodity details" and :45 renders the same string as the h1, and the captured requirements-side page shows "Commodity details" under the caption "About the consignment". Checked the implementation side's three uses in capture/html/frontend/fe-consignment-details.html — <title> at :3, breadcrumb at :98, h1 at :118 — all "Consignment details". Confirmed the citation is a root view and not a release subfolder. CORRECT.
finding.correction: The claim stands and the falsifier does not fire. One citation was a line out and has been fixed: the title string is at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/copy/copy.en.js:16 — line 15 is the consignmentDetails key that opens the block — and both the prose and the evidence path now say :16. The choice to name no control is right: the heading is not a control, and the two page shots carry the comparison.
